newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish ERM decision is whether, not when-Niinisto.
newsitem.headline: Finnish ERM decision is whether, not when-Niinisto.

text.p: Finland's decision on its stance to Europe's exchange rate mechanism ERM will concern whether to peg the markka to the system and not just when to do it, Finance Minister Sauli Niinisto said on Tuesday.
"This government's decision that in the latter half of the year we will decide yes or no (to ERM) is in force," Niinisto told Reuters in a telephone interview.
"The decision to link or not will be made in the latter half of the year," he added.

Asked about Prime Minister Paavo Lipponen's announcement last Friday that the decision is due in the near future, Niinisto said: "Also December starts to be in the near future." He declined to elaborate.

Asked to explain why ERM was not mentioned in Finland's updated convergence programme for Economic and Monetary Union (EMU), he said ERM was a question of going in or staying out, not -- as with other EMU entry criteria -- how a country was approaching the limits set at Maastricht in 1991.
"The question of linkage to ERM is not actually any convergence issue because it is one of yes or nor," he said. @
